correctness.rationale: A full all-parameter proof constructs an admissible acyclic root-link matching and proves root-link collapsibility, then uses star joins, an integral Mayer–Vietoris identification of exterior-power augmentation lattices, Koszul-graded permutations, and the hook Specht irreducibility argument. The standalone checker verifies actual link Hasse DAG acyclicity, GF(2) ranks and signed Lefschetz traces for 1296 elements in one case, plus two other cases; no finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recent qualitative tree theorem motivates the exact problem. For arbitrary independently varying leaf multiplicities, a direct root-link collapse gives a uniform sphere formula, while the integral group-module and parity-sensitive wreath character—irreducible over Q in the symmetric case—are not consequences of the known Betti counts. The concrete r=3,m=s=4 example yields an irreducible 81-dimensional module; this is genuine structural topology rather than a routine isolated enumeration.
